description: This file provides an interactive command-line interface for managing and querying a SQLite database named 'myapp.db'. It includes commands for listing tables, showing schemas, describing tables, and executing SQL queries, facilitating database inspection and management in a shell environment.

methods.name: print_help()
methods.description: Prints help information about available commands in the interactive shell.

methods.name: list_tables(cursor)
methods.description: Lists all user-defined tables in the database excluding internal SQLite tables.

methods.name: show_schema(cursor, table_name=None)
methods.description: Displays the CREATE statement(s) for specified table(s) or all tables if no specific table is provided.

methods.name: describe_table(cursor, table_name)
methods.description: Shows detailed structure of a specific table, including columns, types, nullability, defaults, and primary key info.

methods.name: execute_query(cursor, query)
methods.description: Executes a given SQL query, prints results for SELECT statements, or confirms execution for other statements.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function that runs an interactive loop accepting user commands and SQL queries, managing database connection lifecycle.
